asklokesh-claudeskill-loki-mode-root.description: Runs an autonomous software factory that knows what it is supposed to deliver and proves it did, with a signed receipt. Use when the user says Loki Mode or asks to build, fix or verify software autonomously.

asklokesh-claudeskill-loki-mode-integrat.description: Launch Loki Mode autonomous SDLC agent. Handles PRD-to-deployment with minimal human intervention. Invoke for multi-phase development tasks, bug fixing campaigns, or full product builds.

asklokesh-claudeskill-loki-mode-loki-sea.description: Use when finishing any coding task in a repo with tests. Loki Seal runs the repo's real test suite and refuses to let you declare done while tests newly fail, or while tests or CI config were deleted, skipped, xfailed or weakened. Runs locally with no model calls.
